title: Assassination Classroom
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a tentacled creature destroys most of the Moon and threatens Earth, he becomes homeroom teacher of Class 3-E, the school's outcast class. Students have a year to kill him for a government reward, while he teaches them both school subjects and assassination, and helps each one grow.
life_message: A good life means discovering your own worth through a mentor who believes in you.

content.note: Students train to kill their teacher with guns and knives; outside assassins (Wikipedia; AniList Assassins 98%); removed from some US school libraries over gun violence (Wikipedia).
Threat of world destruction and a tragic backstory.
Challenged in the US over alleged sexualization of minors (Wikipedia); teacher's 'perverted' gags (to verify).
Outcast class bullied by the school system (Wikipedia).
Weapon play aimed at a teacher (Wikipedia library challenges; AniList Assassins tag).
